title: Tech Note: Guide to Converting 4D Write to 4D Write Pro
author: Erick Lui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note documents a mandatory, one-time migration path that 4D itself forced with the move to 64-bit-only builds; the underlying problem (classic 4D Write being 32-bit-only and unsupported past 17.5/17R4) is now ancient history for any active database, since virtually all databases have long since been converted or abandoned classic 4D Write.
related_updates: 4D Write classic is fully retired; 4D Write Pro (HTML/CSS-based, ORDA/collection-friendly) is the only supported rich-text engine since 4D v17R5/v18+

Any database still holding unconverted .4w6/.4w7 documents needs a legacy 32-bit copy of 4D (17.5 or 17 R4 max) to do this conversion, which is now very hard to source and run on modern OSes (Catalina+ dropped 32-bit apps entirely)
